text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet High Contrast Black and White Global Geometric 100% Cotton Throw Blanket
Colors: Gray
Materials: 100% cotton
High contrast black and white and oversized tassels make this throw a standout that can even be hung as wall art. Hand-woven and hand-tied, this global-inspired piece is also soft enough to use as a blanket or snuggle up in on the sofa. 50"W x 60"L Hand woven of 100% cotton Spot clean only.
